activity_summary: You were at Old Swan by two, off the tilt-boat. You did not tell the middle of the river. Gannet had three pieces of news, and you kept one: Twelfth Day, which Kettleby had already brought. There was no ice, and the Queen had not paid you in the boat. Nick asked what a queen does when she is a man, and you told him he learns to stand differently, and that he has time. He did not sing. Kemp wants the ass's head by Candlemas, with the ears a hand longer than the head. The baskets had gone on to Shoreditch in a cart. Heminges did not name a house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the middle of the river, corrected the ice and the payment, and kept the ear.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Landed you, offered three news, and kept the one you did not correct.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Asked the question in the new voice, and went with Phillips without singing.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept a ballad off Fish Street, and took Nick.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Set Candlemas for the head, and a hand's length for the ears.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Sent the baskets on by cart, and refused to name a house.

entities.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon
entities.context: Not at the stair. His Twelfth Day was the one true piece of the three.

facets.activity: Landed at Old Swan, answered Nick, and took Kemp's measure for the ears

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He learns to stand differently. Thou'st time.

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: What does a queen do, when she is a man?

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: The ears a hand longer than the head.
